v5.label: Kilix V5, before direct weight edits

prompt_change: Append two LFM2-only sentences requiring native output only and spelling out the exact empty block. No weights, tools, parser, or admission changes.
limits: Previously used synthetic suites; this is a post-selection prompt comparison, not a new holdout.
Conditional command accuracy excludes format and schema failures; also report coverage and all-case correctness.
Prose responses remain format failures, with no inferred semantic refusal credit.
CPU/GPU jobs can overlap; no new latency claims from these accuracy runs.

definitions.native_syntax: A complete response parsed by the unchanged native parser, regardless of tool-schema validity or correctness.
definitions.tool_schema: A syntactically valid response whose names and arguments pass the frozen independent scorer schema.
definitions.conditional_command_accuracy: Exact ordered tool and literal-argument correctness among schema-valid responses only. Reported together with all-case correctness and schema coverage.
definitions.all_case_command_accuracy: Exact model correctness over every case; format, runtime and schema errors fail.
definitions.application_acceptance: Correct supported proposals accepted by the unchanged whole-request validator. No proposal is executed. A wrong proposal rejected on an unsupported request can produce a correct no-action outcome; the model proposal remains incorrect.
definitions.prose: Prose-only refusals fail native format. Their meaning is not independently graded or credited as a correct abstention.
definitions.runtime_error: No usable complete response reaches the native parser; distinct from format errors.

prompt_decision: Retain the original prompt: every clarification lost at least one previously correct .21 development answer. One tied the total but exchanged a loss for a gain. No weight change or model re-selection.
